ارثعنوا (form IVq)
# اِرْثَعَنُّوا (irṯaʕannū) /ir.θa.ʕan.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْثَعَنَّ (irṯaʕanna)
# اِرْثَعِنُّوا (irṯaʕinnū) /ir.θa.ʕin.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْثَعَنَّ (irṯaʕanna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
